verdicts.reason: A: the headline-first order mostly holds, but 'WEEKEND ONLY' has been moved away from the headline and sits above the button. The can has shrunk to a meaningless sliver squeezed against the CTA, and the three-line legal text is tiny and jammed against the right edge. The legal text is clipped at the bottom edge ('responsibly' is cut off) and crowds the headline. B's larger can doesn't make up for the cut-off text and the broken hierarchy.
